sample_unit: simulated cohort (thousands): 1,197,818 non-Indigenous and 65,160 Indigenous people with diabetes
unlisted_practices: Cost-effectiveness modelling of AI-based diabetic retinopathy screening in primary care versus current manual grading, including universal screening scenarios

screen.reason: This study is a decision-analytic Markov simulation modeling the population impact and cost-effectiveness of an AI-based diabetic retinopathy screening program across various implementation scenarios.
